chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I said, “Are the two rak'ahs of dawn part of salat al-layl?” He said, “Yes.”

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ: the two units of prayer being asked about
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative response confirming the ruling
key_terms.ٱللَّيْلِ: the night; here referring to the night prayer
key_terms.ٱلْفَجْرِ: dawn; here referring to the two rak'ahs associated with dawn

ai.seo_question: Are the two rak'ahs of dawn considered part of salat al-layl?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the two rak'ahs of dawn are counted as part of salat al-layl. It is a brief legal narration relevant to the rulings and structure of recommended night prayer.
